title: Unified data platform
subtitle: One shared lake underneath; every workload sits at its own height above it.
note: SYNTHETIC illustration of a Fabric-like platform. Generic names, no logos; not a vendor reference architecture or a real tenant.

layers.label: Shared lake
layers.description: One logical lake. Every item keeps its tables as open columnar files here, so engines read one copy instead of duplicating it.

layers.label: Data items
layers.description: Stores that live on the lake: lakehouse, warehouse and event store, plus the external systems that feed them.

layers.label: Engines
layers.description: Compute that moves and shapes data: pipelines, notebooks and event streams.

layers.label: Models & endpoints
layers.description: Business meaning and access: semantic models, query endpoints and identity.

layers.label: Reports & apps
layers.description: What people open: reports, live dashboards, alert rules and partner apps.

layers.label: People
layers.description: Analysts and operators who read and act on the results.

domains.label: External sources
domains.description: Systems outside the platform that produce data.

domains.label: Sales domain
domains.description: Batch analytics workspace: orders to revenue reports.

domains.label: Operations domain
domains.description: Real-time workspace: sensor readings to live dashboards and alerts.

nodes.label: Shared lake
nodes.description: Single storage layer for every workspace. Tables are kept once as open columnar (Delta/Parquet) files; each engine reads the same copy.

nodes.label: ERP database
nodes.description: Operational system of record for orders and customers. Read by a scheduled copy; never written by the platform.

nodes.label: Plant sensors
nodes.description: Field devices that emit temperature and vibration readings every few seconds.

nodes.label: Sales lakehouse
nodes.description: Raw (bronze) and cleaned (silver) tables for the sales domain, stored as files in the shared lake.

nodes.label: Sales warehouse
nodes.description: Curated (gold) star schema with SQL tables for reporting.

nodes.label: Telemetry store
nodes.description: Time-partitioned event store optimised for recent-window queries over sensor readings.

nodes.label: Nightly copy
nodes.description: Scheduled pipeline that copies changed ERP rows into the lakehouse raw zone.

nodes.label: Cleaning notebook
nodes.description: Spark notebook that deduplicates and types raw tables into silver, then builds gold aggregates.

nodes.label: Sensor stream
nodes.description: Event stream that receives device readings, filters them and routes them into the telemetry store.

nodes.label: Sales model
nodes.description: Semantic model: relationships, measures (revenue, margin) and row-level rules over the warehouse.

nodes.label: Query endpoint
nodes.description: Read-only SQL/GraphQL endpoint that exposes curated tables to applications.

nodes.label: Workspace identity
nodes.description: Single sign-on and workspace roles. Every report, endpoint and item checks it before answering.

nodes.label: Revenue report
nodes.description: Interactive report on the sales model: revenue by region, month and product.

nodes.label: Live dashboard
nodes.description: Auto-refreshing tiles over the last hour of sensor readings.

nodes.label: Threshold alert
nodes.description: Rule that fires when a reading crosses its threshold and notifies the on-call operator.

nodes.label: Partner web app
nodes.description: External web application that reads curated data through the query endpoint.

nodes.label: Analysts
nodes.description: Business analysts who explore revenue and share findings.

nodes.label: Operators
nodes.description: Plant operators who watch live readings and respond to alerts.
